item.title: The Science Of How AI Pays Attention
item.description: An analysis of 1.2 million ChatGPT citations reveals why AI favors front-loaded, entity-rich, definitive writing over traditional “ultimate guide” formats. The post The Science Of How AI Pays Attention appeared first on Search Engine Journal.

item.title: Google Text Ad Click Share Rises Sharply In Some Verticals
item.description: An analysis of approximately 16,000 U.S. queries shows text ads increasing their click share by 7-13 points year over year. The post Google Text Ad Click Share Rises Sharply In Some Verticals appeared first on Search Engine Journal.

item.title: 4 Pillars To Turn Your “Sticky-Taped” Tech Stack Into a Modern Publishing Engine
item.description: Discover how a modern publishing engine can eliminate the issues of legacy CMS and drive sustainable growth for media companies. The post 4 Pillars To Turn Your “Sticky-Taped” Tech Stack Into a Modern Publishing Engine appeared first on Search Engine Journal.

item.title: Google Says Links Will Be More Visible In AI Overviews
item.description: Google is adding hover link pop-ups on desktop in AI Overviews and AI Mode, plus more prominent link icons within responses across desktop and mobile. The post Google Says Links Will Be More Visible In AI Overviews appeared first on Search Engine Journal.

item.title: 5 Ways Emerging Businesses Can Show up in ChatGPT, Gemini & Perplexity
item.description: AI models default to familiar brands. What makes them mention your company instead of a bigger or more established competitor? The post 5 Ways Emerging Businesses Can Show up in ChatGPT, Gemini & Perplexity appeared first on Search Engine Journal.

item.title: How To Set Up AI Prompt Tracking You Can Trust [Webinar]

item.title: Enterprise SEO Operating Models That Scale In 2026 And Beyond
item.description: Move SEO upstream into leadership decisions to safeguard visibility, enforce standards, and scale sustainable search performance. The post Enterprise SEO Operating Models That Scale In 2026 And Beyond appeared first on Search Engine Journal.

item.title: Are Citations In AI Search Affected By Google Organic Visibility Changes?
item.description: An analysis of 11 impacted sites reveals a strong correlation between Google visibility losses and declining AI search citations, with ChatGPT hit hardest. The post Are Citations In AI Search Affected By Google Organic Visibility Changes? appeared first on Search Engine Journal.

item.title: Why Google Runs AI Mode On Flash, Explained By Google’s Chief Scientist
item.description: Google's Jeff Dean explains why latency and cost make Flash Google's production tier for AI search, and why models are built to retrieve, not memorize. The post Why Google Runs AI Mode On Flash, Explained By Google’s Chief Scientist appeared first on Search Engine Journal.

item.title: ChatGPT Search Often Switches To English In Fan-Out Queries: Report
item.description: Peec AI analyzed fan-out queries from 10M+ ChatGPT prompts and found 43% of background searches ran in English, even for non-English prompts. The post ChatGPT Search Often Switches To English In Fan-Out Queries: Report appeared first on Search Engine Journal.
